import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
def to_date(d):
    p = d.split('/')
    return f"{p[2]}-{int(p[0]):02d}-{int(p[1]):02d}"
sub['dt'] = sub.date.map(to_date)

# Baseline: use 10/1 to 10/19
base = sub[(sub.dt>='25-10-01')&(sub.dt<='25-10-19')]
anom = sub[sub.dt=='25-10-20']

cols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
def agg(d):
    return d.groupby(cols)['unblended_cost'].sum()

b = agg(base).groupby(cols).mean()
a = agg(anom)
comp = pd.concat({'base': b, 'anom': a}, axis=1).fillna(0)
comp['diff'] = comp['anom']-comp['base']
print(comp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(15))
